question:
Re-read each record against its first-party page and establish the values its unknown classes name, at least the retention and per-object-cap notes, plus any interface, chaining, retention, per-object-cap or egress value listed for it.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- storage/greencloudvps-storage-kvm $.interface: Page names a 10Gbps port and RAID-10 SATA disks; it says nothing of rest, sftp, rsync or rclone interfaces.
- storage/google-drive-shared-drives-written-by-service-accounts $.egress.terms: Page gives "1 TiB (not yet enforced)" per day per project; says nothing on per-GB egress charges or drive.usercontent.google.com; claim calls it a new ceiling and writes TB not TiB.
- storage/google-chat-spaces-as-a-quota-exempt-attachment-store $.egress.terms: Cited page supports only Range requests. 3,000 reads/min/project is in a different capture (chat/limits) and the page has no statement about charges, so "not metered / no per-GB charge" is not stated.
- storage/google-drive-shared-drives-written-by-service-accounts $.chaining: Page supports service accounts having no quota and uploading to shared drives. It has no 750 GB/day per identity, N x 750 GB ingest, or 100 TB pool statement for Drive shared drives.
- storage/google-drive-shared-drives-written-by-service-accounts $.egress.metered: Page only states a 1 TiB per-day-per-project egress quota not yet enforced; no statement that egress is unmetered or free.
- storage/gofile $.chaining: API page supports account creation with no token and 10,000 contents cap; it has no 100 GB/30-day per-guest traffic bucket, and says to create one account and not mint one per upload.
- storage/google-chat-spaces-as-a-quota-exempt-attachment-store $.interface: Quote is a rate-limit table row; nothing about interface or rclone for Chat attachments.
- storage/google-for-startups-cloud-program $.retention.notes: Only "Program qualifications change annually" is on the page; one-year Start credits, Year 1/Year 2 Scale grant and non-transferability are not stated.
- storage/google-for-startups-cloud-program $.identity_cost.kind: Page says startups with funding; it excludes educational institutions. Nothing states identity cost kind institution.
- storage/google-drive-shared-drives-written-by-service-accounts $.limits[0].value: 400,000,000 quota units/day not in capture; the page says nothing of quotas.
- storage/google-chat-spaces-as-a-quota-exempt-attachment-store $.retention.notes: Vault page says retention period "from 1 to 36,500" days, not 30 to 36500; no mention of supported editions.
- storage/google-for-startups-cloud-program $.egress.free_allowance: Page refers to Always Free usage limits but gives no 200 GB per month figure.
